_note: Tyres for Track sessions (track.html). Makes with the models the Model box suggests (any model can still be typed), and the sizes for the Width, Profile and Diameter drop-downs. Edit the makes and sizes here, or use the Tyres panel on admin.html, which stores its changes on top of this file.
_infoNote: What the maker and the EU tyre label say about a model, keyed Make|Model: category, wet grip and rolling resistance grades (A to E) and noise (dB) for the size given (grades differ by size and OE marking), EV rated, notes and the page it came from. Found by web search in October 2026 from retailer listings of the label and EPREL fiches, worth checking. The Tyres panel of track-admin.html (Maker data) stores changes on top.

Michelin|Pilot Sport 4S.notes: Michelin's UHP summer tyre for sports and performance cars, strong dry and wet grip and precise steering.

Michelin|Pilot Sport 4.notes: Sporty summer tyre for fast road use, dynamic response with good wet braking and longevity.

Michelin|Pilot Sport 5.notes: Successor to Pilot Sport 4: sporty summer tyre with long tread life and high wet and dry grip.

Michelin|Pilot Sport EV.notes: Summer performance tyre designed for electric cars: grip for instant torque, low noise and range in mind.

Michelin|Pilot Sport Cup 2.notes: Road-legal track tyre with extreme dry grip for circuit use, asymmetric tread; usable on the road.

Michelin|Pilot Sport Cup 2 Connect.notes: Road-legal track tyre with the Cup 2 tread and compound, for track days and fast road use.

Michelin|Pilot Sport Cup 2 R.notes: Road-legal semi-slick for the fastest track lap times, minimal tread, derived from Cup 2.

Michelin|Pilot Super Sport.notes: Older Michelin UHP summer tyre developed from endurance racing, dry grip and high-speed stability.

Michelin|Pilot Sport A/S 4.notes: North American UHP all-season tyre; not sold with an EU label.

Michelin|Primacy 4+.notes: Touring summer tyre with wet braking kept to the end of its life, safety and long mileage.

Michelin|e.Primacy.notes: Eco touring summer tyre with very low rolling resistance, marketed as ideal for electric and hybrid cars.

Michelin|CrossClimate 2.notes: All-season tyre with 3PMSF snow rating, summer-tyre dry and wet braking with winter capability.

Michelin|Pilot Alpin 5.notes: Winter tyre for performance cars, 3PMSF, grip on snow and in cold wet conditions.

Pirelli|P Zero.notes: Pirelli's UHP summer tyre, many OE-specific versions whose label grades differ by marking.

Pirelli|P Zero PZ4.notes: Fourth-generation P Zero (Sports Car version), UHP summer tyre; OE versions carry different grades.

Pirelli|P Zero Trofeo R.notes: Road-legal tyre intended mainly for track use on dry surfaces, steering precision at high temperatures.

Pirelli|P Zero Trofeo RS.notes: Latest road-legal track tyre, successor to Trofeo R, for dry track use and lap times.

Pirelli|P Zero Corsa.notes: Road-legal track-oriented tyre (Corsa Asimmetrico 2), racing-derived compound for dry grip.

Pirelli|P Zero Corsa PZC4.notes: Current P Zero Corsa, road-legal track tyre for supercars with racing-derived compound.

Pirelli|P Zero Elect.notes: Elect marking: P Zero E built for electric cars, low rolling resistance, low noise and grip for torque.

Pirelli|Cinturato P7.notes: Touring summer tyre (P7C2 generation) for comfort, mileage and efficiency with good wet handling.

Pirelli|Cinturato Winter.notes: Winter tyre (Cinturato Winter 2), 3PMSF, for city and motorway use in cold, wet and snowy conditions.

Goodyear|Eagle F1 Asymmetric 5.notes: Previous-generation UHP summer tyre, short wet braking and precise handling.

Goodyear|Eagle F1 SuperSport.notes: Ultra-UHP summer tyre for sports cars, track-derived grip while remaining a road tyre.

Goodyear|Eagle F1 SuperSport R.notes: Road-legal tyre tuned for track days, stiffer construction and more dry grip than SuperSport.

Goodyear|Eagle Sport 2.notes: Sporty summer tyre (Eagle Sport 2 UHP) for everyday performance cars.

Goodyear|EfficientGrip Performance 2.notes: Touring summer tyre with high mileage and good wet grip.
